verdict.rationale: Expensify documents SmartScan, which automatically reads merchant, date, total and currency from receipts. It also documents auto-categorization based on policies and past behavior, and matching receipts to card transactions to avoid duplicate entries. Hands-on reports are mixed: one user says amounts are read well but categories are wrong about 70% of the time, and another reports slow scans and MTurk workers seeing receipts. missing for 10: AI-suggested memos, fraud or anomaly detection beyond card matching, and independent corroboration of categorization accuracy.
